aboutMe.bio: I have been professionally creating complete websites or parts of them for six years. I gained experience at large corporations where I worked as a coder/front-end developer, programmer, and designer. Later, I specialized in PPC advertising with expertise in web analytics and SEO. I now use these experiences as a freelancer in Prague.

faqItems.question: Why choose a freelance web designer?
faqItems.answer: A freelance web designer can offer great value at a reasonable price compared to agencies while providing top-quality websites and a more personal approach.

faqItems.question: What areas do you cover?
faqItems.answer: I've been working remotely for years with businesses of all sizes. I've worked with clients based in Prague, Brno, London, Saigon, Da Nang, Bruchsal, and Berlin.

faqItems.question: What's the difference between a freelance web designer and a freelance web developer?
faqItems.answer: A web designer designs how things will look and feel, usually in applications like Figma or Sketch. A developer then implements that design into an interactive form in a web browser. I have years of experience and knowledge in both areas, so I can be a great asset for businesses wanting to bridge the gap between design and development.

faqItems.question: What services do you offer?
faqItems.answer: PPC advertising, SEO, Branding and corporate identity, Wireframes and prototyping, User experience design (UX), User interface design (UI), Mobile app design, Banners and social media content, Animations, Print materials, Coding, Programming, Web maintenance, E-shops

servicePages.title: Website and e-shop development | LEDU
servicePages.seoDescription: Brochure websites and e-shops on WordPress, Next.js and React. Design, build and handover of a site you can continue with SEO or PPC.
servicePages.lead: I design and build websites and e-shops for companies. Depending on the brief I use WordPress, Next.js or React. I hand the site over so it can be edited and followed by further work, such as SEO or PPC.
included: Page structure and visual design
Development on WordPress, Next.js or React
Layout for phone, tablet and desktop
An e-shop when it is part of the brief
Basic search setup: addresses, titles and descriptions
Handover of access and the site for further care

process.title: Consultation
process.text: We go through what the site must do, who it is for, and what you already have.

process.title: Design
process.text: I prepare the page structure and the look.

process.title: Build
process.text: I develop the site, add the content you supply, and check it on common devices.

process.title: Handover
process.text: I launch the site, hand over access, and we agree any further edits.

faq.question: What do you build websites with?
faq.answer: WordPress, Next.js or React. The choice follows the brief: an editorial site, an e-shop, or an application that has to do more than static pages.

faq.question: Do you build e-shops?
faq.answer: Yes, when an e-shop is part of the brief. The scope, such as a catalogue and ordering, follows what the shop needs to do.

faq.question: Can the site be edited after handover?
faq.answer: On WordPress, text is edited in the admin. On Next.js or React it depends whether the content lives in code or in an admin. How edits work is part of the brief.

faq.question: Do you also handle SEO and PPC for the site?
faq.answer: Basic technical search setup is part of the handover. Ongoing SEO and PPC campaigns are separate services.

servicePages.ctaTitle: A site shaped by the brief
servicePages.ctaText: Tell me what the site needs to do. I will get back to you about a no-obligation consultation.

servicePages.title: SEO for company websites | LEDU
servicePages.seoDescription: SEO for companies: technical state of the site, page structure and content edits. No guarantee of a specific ranking.
servicePages.lead: I adjust a website so a search engine can crawl it and relate it to the topics of your field. I work on the technical side, the page structure and the text. I do not guarantee a specific position.
included: Review of indexing, titles, headings and internal links
A page structure based on the topics of the field
Edits to titles, descriptions and headings
Notes on text that is missing or unclear
Technical edits that can be made on the current site

process.title: Consultation
process.text: I look at the current site and at what people should be able to find there.

process.title: List of edits
process.text: I write down what gets in the way of search and what is worth doing first.

process.title: Implementation
process.text: I make the edits on the site, or I prepare them for whoever maintains it.

process.title: Check
process.text: After the edits I check whether the search engine can see the pages. Rankings move with a delay, and I do not promise a position.

faq.question: What is SEO?
faq.answer: Changes to a website and its content so a search engine can find the pages and show them to people looking for that topic.

faq.question: Do you guarantee the top positions?
faq.answer: No. The search engine decides the order. It depends on competition, content and links from other sites. I make the changes that give you a basis for that. A place in the results cannot be promised.

faq.question: When does a change show up?
faq.answer: Search engines react with a delay. It often takes months, not days. I do not name a date when a page will move.

faq.question: Does the website have to be new?
faq.answer: No. SEO can be done on the site you already have. If the site is still being built, I handle the edits together with the build.

servicePages.ctaText: Tell me what site you have and what people should find on it.

servicePages.title: PPC advertising in Google Ads and Sklik | LEDU
servicePages.seoDescription: PPC campaigns in Google Ads and Sklik. Campaign structure, ad copy and ongoing management based on what the account shows.
servicePages.lead: I set up and manage search ads in Google Ads and Sklik. The ad leads to a page where the visitor can write or call. I adjust campaigns based on what the account shows.
included: Campaign structure in Google Ads or Sklik
Ad copy
A link to the page that should turn a visit into an enquiry
Ongoing management: copy edits and pausing ad groups that do not bring enquiries
Enquiry measurement where the website allows it

process.title: Consultation
process.text: What should be advertised, and which page the click should open.

process.title: Proposal
process.text: Campaign structure and copy for approval.

process.title: Launch
process.text: I start the campaign after it is approved in the ads account.

process.title: Management
process.text: I adjust copy and ad groups based on the data in the account.

faq.question: What is PPC?
faq.answer: Advertising where you pay per click. The ad appears in search or on another network depending on how the campaign is set up.

faq.question: Does PPC fit with SEO?
faq.answer: They are two different things. PPC brings visits after the campaign starts. SEO works on unpaid results and takes longer. They can run side by side.

faq.question: Do I need a new website?
faq.answer: I need a page the ad can open. It can be the site you already have. If that page is unclear or missing, we adjust the site first.

servicePages.ctaTitle: A page first, then the campaign
servicePages.ctaText: Tell me what you want to advertise. We will go through it in a consultation.

servicePages.title: Graphic design and website design | LEDU
servicePages.seoDescription: Graphic design for companies: website look, identity, banners, social assets and print. The design can be part of the website build.
servicePages.lead: I design the look of a website and the graphics that belong with it. That covers page layout, identity elements, banners and print assets when they are part of the brief.
included: Look and layout of the website
Wireframes and a page prototype
Branding and identity when it is part of the brief
Banners and assets for social networks
Print materials
Animation and a mobile app interface when they are part of the brief

process.title: Materials
process.text: We go through what you already have: logo, text, photos and examples you like.

process.title: Design
process.text: I prepare a direction and the specific pages or materials.

process.title: Revisions
process.text: I apply your comments.

process.title: Handover
process.text: You receive the files. If I also build the site, I put the design into it.

faq.question: Is the design part of building the website?
faq.answer: It can be. I do design and development as one job, or only the graphics when someone else builds the site.

faq.question: Do you also deliver a logo?
faq.answer: Yes, when identity is part of the brief. If you already have a logo, I work from it.

faq.question: What do I get at the end?
faq.answer: Files for the website and for the materials that were in the brief. The handover format depends on whether I implement the graphics or someone else does.

servicePages.ctaTitle: The brief first, then the visual
servicePages.ctaText: Tell me whether you need a website design, an identity, or both.

servicePages.title: Process automation with n8n, Supabase and AI | LEDU
servicePages.seoDescription: Automation of repeated steps in n8n and Supabase, with AI at a specific point in the workflow. Connecting data and the actions that follow.
servicePages.lead: I build a workflow that carries out repeated steps. n8n connects the steps, Supabase holds the data, and I use AI only where a model should read, sort or draft something.
included: Design and setup of a workflow in n8n
A Supabase database for records the workflow stores and reads
A connection to the channel in the brief, such as a form or email
An AI step when the process has a specific task for a model
Handover of a scenario that runs on your side

process.title: The manual work
process.text: We write down the steps that are done by hand today and where the data comes from.

process.title: Design
process.text: What should start the workflow, where the data is stored, and where a model steps in.

process.title: Build
process.text: I build it in n8n and Supabase and connect the inputs we agreed.

process.title: Trial
process.text: We walk through a real case and I hand over what the workflow needs to run.

faq.question: What is n8n?
faq.answer: A tool for automatic processes. One step starts the next, for example receiving data and writing it to a database.

faq.question: What is Supabase doing there?
faq.answer: It is the database and backend. The workflow stores records there and reads them back.

faq.question: Where does AI come in?
faq.answer: In one step of the process, not as a replacement for the whole process. The model typically reads, sorts or drafts text. Which model depends on the brief. In the internal LeadHunter tool it is Claude.

faq.question: Is LeadHunter a client project?
faq.answer: No. It is an internal LEDU pipeline on n8n, Supabase and Claude that finds leads. It has no public address.

servicePages.ctaTitle: The manual process first, then automation
servicePages.ctaText: Describe the step that keeps repeating. In a consultation we will see whether a workflow can take it.
